pm_experience.notes: App is functional. Auth works via localStorage injection. Two active sessions visible. Tool calls render as clickable blocks with detail view navigation. Tables render with proper columns. AskUserQuestion renders with clickable option buttons. Mobile layout has bottom tab navigation. Key finding: file upload/attachment button is MISSING from input toolbar -- only settings gear, info, git diff stats, and send button are present. This confirms user's report that file upload feature disappeared after merge with origin. No console errors detected. All API calls to api-dev.life-ai.app return 200. The session data in these test sessions does not contain Agent/Task tool calls, Edit diffs, Mermaid diagrams, or LaTeX content -- specialists will need to find or create sessions with those content types to verify rendering.

strategic_notes: This is cycle 1 after a major merge with happy origin. The user's primary concern is comprehensive functional verification of all Claude tool visualization, plus specific feature regressions (file upload disappeared, known unfixed bugs). The dev account has 2 active sessions with some tool call content but lacks Agent/Task blocks, Edit diffs, Mermaid, or LaTeX content for comprehensive rendering tests. Specialists should look for production-like sessions with rich content or analyze the rendering code paths directly. The file upload disappearance is the highest-signal issue -- the Feature #2 implementation (10+ files) may have been lost or conflicted during merge. Both the app-side UI code (AgentInput attachment button, useAttachments hook) and server-side routes (fileRoutes.ts) need verification.
